planted_comparison_caveat.note: Framing correction (lead, 2026-09-26; results/switchbench_explore.md, commits 039db99 / 1c479e8): tifxyz-doctor's published 124/128 planted recall was measured on 12.5-voxel-grid traces and its score is divided by grid step; on 20-voxel traces like ours its defaults catch the planted 8-voxel step only 6/128. Natural recall vs 0.969 planted is not like-for-like and is not a headline. C1 is an absolute bound and is unaffected.
planted_comparison_caveat.exploratory_v0_matched_spacing: EXPLORATORY (v0 data): at the threshold that catches the planted 8-voxel step 124/128 on 20-voxel traces (ratio 0.17), natural recall 14/54 = 0.26 [0.16-0.39] at 1.9 FA/100 mm; all default hits are abrupt events (6/24 abrupt vs 0/30 gradual)
